question: P completes a work in 12 days and Q in 24 days. In how many days P and Q working together can complete the same work?
solution:
**Given:**

P completes a work in 12 days and Q in 24 days.

**Formula used:**

Work rate of P = 1/12 work/day

Work rate of Q = 1/24 work/day

Combined work rate of P and Q = 1/12 + 1/24 work/day

**Calculation:**

Combined work rate = 1/12 + 1/24

⇒ Combined work rate = 2/24 + 1/24

⇒ Combined work rate = 3/24

⇒ Combined work rate = 1/8 work/day
